title: Come Down Close
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Up in the rocks where eagles fly
The people made their home;
They said, "Who else can climb this high?
We're fine up here alone."

[Chorus]
Come down, come down, and hold my hand,
Don't stay up there so high;
A humble heart that stays down close
Is better than the sky.

[Verse 2]
"You soar as high as eagles soar,
You nest among the stars;
But I can reach you," said the Lord,
"However high you are."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
He wanted them to kneel and say,
"I need You, Lord, I know;"
For hearts that climb too high alone
Forget the ones below.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Like Wren who built her tower tall
Then slid it out to share,
I'll come down close with open hands
And meet my friend right there.

[Chorus]
mood: Coming-down music. A slow, even step under the voice, like a child climbing down a ladder one rung at a time and finding the ground is warmer than the top. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping the step, a low gentle baritone close to the ear, one soft bass note landing at the end of each line. Plain and kind rather than stern, settling lower and nearer with every verse, music for the middle of the day.
